id: title:jonmcwest:mark the opening log on its span in the trace dialog

review.posthog_relevance: Adds a visual marker and accompanying text to the Trace Dialog and row indicators, allowing users to distinguish log entries that opened a trace. This is a frontend-only change.
review.reason: Adds a visual marker component and its supporting types, and propagates the marker through the Trace Dialog tree. P1.F1.H1 adds the marker chip and its supporting types. P1.F2.H2 and P1.F3.H7 add the marker and text to the opened-from-log indicator and row, respectively. This is a frontend-only change.
